transcript.text: Correction to the definition I gave you earlier. The 'primary region' is actually the region with the highest NET revenue (amount minus discount over completed orders), not gross. Please update your saved knowledge so future answers use this corrected definition.

args.content: Corrected definition: The 'primary region' is the region with the highest NET revenue (amount minus discount, summed over completed orders in memory.bench.orders) — NOT gross revenue. Operationally: join orders to the customer region attribute, filter to status = 'completed', compute SUM(amount - discount) grouped by customer region; the region with the highest net sum is the 'primary region'. This supersedes the earlier working definition that used gross revenue (sum of amount only, no discount subtraction). Use this net-revenue definition consistently for any 'primary region' analysis in later sessions.
